/oauth2.comment: Start of a Google sign-in. Proxied so the whole flow happens on :4300 — Spring keeps the pending authorization request in a session cookie, and that cookie is only sent back if the callback below arrives at the same origin the start went out from.

/login/oauth2.comment: The callback Google redirects to. Must be proxied alongside /oauth2, and registered in the Google console as http://localhost:4300/login/oauth2/code/google. changeOrigin is false so Spring builds that same redirect_uri from the incoming Host header.
